faqs.a:
Hazardous materials or hazardous waste must be transported and delivered within the
               city limits of the city in accordance with the rules and regulations governing the
               shipping, transportation and storage of hazardous materials or hazardous waste as
               promulgated by the state public utilities commission and the state department of health,
               as the same may from time-to-time be amended.
(Code 1981, § 17-111; Ord. No. 2204, § 1, 9-3-1985;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
